get.description: Fetches the match context, local FLA mappings and FLA standings snapshot, then returns Java-calculated metrics only. The FLA standings snapshot is cached for 6 hours by default. forceRefresh=true bypasses the cache and refreshes FLA data only; this stage does not generate AI reports.

parameters.description: Force refresh FLA standings snapshot cache. true bypasses cache and refreshes FLA data only.
